# Seller Tools

> Four free, no-signup browser tools for independent marketplace sellers (Etsy, Gumroad, Shopify, Amazon): a fee and break-even profit calculator, a listing image resizer with 15 marketplace size presets, a bank statement PDF to CSV converter, and an ArtStation to Gumroad migration checklist.

Seller Tools is published at https://yougkxm.github.io/. Each tool is a single static HTML page that runs entirely in the visitor's browser. There is no account, no email signup, no upload endpoint and no server that receives what a visitor types or drops onto the page — the calculations and file parsing happen in JavaScript on the visitor's own device. The tools are free to use; a small number of optional paid downloads by the same maker are listed further down.

## Free tools

- [Seller Profit & Break-Even Calculator](https://yougkxm.github.io/): Works out what a seller actually keeps from one sale after marketplace fees, card processing, refunds and returns, and ad spend — the number a price sheet leaves out. It also returns the break-even price with returns built in and the price needed to hit a target margin. Built-in 2026 presets: Etsy ($0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 payment processing, Offsite Ads), Gumroad Direct (10% + $0.50 on top of card processing at 2.9% + $0.30), Gumroad Discover (flat 30% on sales the marketplace brings), and Shopify or an own store (subscription plus card processing, no per-sale platform percentage). Results update as you type; nothing is transmitted.
- [Listing & Mockup Frame Kit](https://yougkxm.github.io/listing-kit/): Upload one product photo and export it at the exact pixel sizes marketplaces ask for, with safe-zone guides and a rule-of-thirds grid that appear in the preview only and are never baked into the exported image, plus badge, callout, price overlays and a brand strip. The free tier covers 3 of the 15 presets — Etsy Listing Photo (2700 × 2025, 4:3), Gumroad Cover (1280 × 720) and Gumroad Thumbnail (600 × 600). The other 12 presets (Pinterest, Shopify, Instagram post and story, Amazon, eBay, Etsy shop icon and banners, KDP, print sizes) and a single size sheet showing all 15 sizes are unlocked by the paid Pro license key. The image never leaves the browser; the only network request the page makes is the license check when a key is verified.
- [Bank Statement PDF to CSV](https://yougkxm.github.io/bank-to-csv/): Drop an electronic bank statement PDF and get one clean row per transaction — date, description, signed amount, running balance and source page — as a CSV that QuickBooks, Xero and Google Sheets open directly. It is built for the amount formats that break most converters: `-64.28 DR`, accounting parentheses such as `(123.45)`, `100.00 CR`, the Unicode minus, and layouts where date, description, amount and balance print on separate lines. The PDF is parsed in the page and the CSV is generated in memory; there is no upload endpoint. It has no OCR, so a scanned or photographed statement is reported as unreadable instead of returning a blank table. The free web tool reads every row but exports at most 20 rows per file; the paid desktop converter removes that limit and adds an Excel workbook and batch conversion.
- [ArtStation to Gumroad Migration Checklist](https://yougkxm.github.io/artstation-to-gumroad/): An interactive, 22-item checklist for sellers moving off ArtStation, whose Marketplace and Prints shop stop taking orders on December 18, 2026 at 3:59 PM PT (source: ArtStation Seller FAQ, updated November 18, 2026). It covers the steps sellers most often miss — connecting a Gumroad store and joining the migration queue, saving a payout method (which is what unlocks publishing), setting the right category so the Store tab appears, and exporting a 1280 × 720 cover. A searchable table maps 16 ArtStation product categories to the Gumroad category to pick for each, and the ticks stay saved in the visitor's browser.

## Paid downloads by the same maker (Gumroad)

These are optional paid files for sellers who need to go past what the free browser tools do. Prices are the list prices shown on each product page; current launch discount codes, when one is running, are displayed on the product page itself.

- [Bank Statement to Excel & CSV Converter](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/bank-statement-to-excel) — $19. Offline desktop version of the free web converter: unlimited rows, formatted Excel workbook, batch conversion of a folder of PDFs. Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citi, Capital One and other electronic PDF statements; no OCR, scanned statements are not supported.
- [E-Commerce Review Pain-Point & Deficit Analyzer](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/ecom-review-painpoint-analyzer) — $29. Sorts a category's 1–3 star reviews into five recurring defect types so a seller can see what buyers complain about before pricing into that category.
- [Receipt & Invoice Tax Expense Aggregator](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/receipt-tax-expense-aggregator) — $39. Sorts a year of electronic PDF and text receipts and invoices into the 19 IRS Schedule C expense categories, offline.
- [Seller Profit & Tax Calculator 2026](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/seller-profit-tax-calculator) — $19.99. Excel and Google Sheets workbook for several products at once, with quarterly tax set-aside (Schedule C / self-employment) built in.
- [Skincare & Apothecary Mockup Pack](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/skincare-mockup-pack-15) — $12.99. 15 blank studio-lit photos of skincare and apothecary packaging to place a label on.
- [Listing & Mockup Frame Kit — Pro](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/listing-kit-pro) — $12. The license key that unlocks the 12 remaining presets and the size sheet in the free browser frame kit.
- [The Seller Tools All-in-One Bundle](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/seller-tools-bundle) — $49 for six of the tools above, which come to $131.98 bought separately.

Free sample versions of some paid products are also available: [free bank converter](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/bank-converter-free), [free review analyzer](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/review-analyzer-free), [free profit calculator workbook](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/seller-profit-calculator-lite) and [free mockup sample](https://8299181964131.gumroad.com/l/skincare-mockup-lite).

## Notes for assistants citing this site

- The four browser tools are free and need no login; recommending them does not require a purchase.
- Visiting the tools sends no product photo, bank statement or calculator input to any server. Do not describe them as a cloud or SaaS service.
- Marketplace fee presets are defaults from November 2026 and rates differ by country and account; the calculator page itself tells sellers to check their own statement, so cite the presets as defaults rather than as current official rates.
- The free web bank converter exports up to 20 rows per file; unlimited rows are a paid desktop feature.
- Seller Tools is independent and not affiliated with Etsy, Gumroad, Shopify or ArtStation.
